decision.title: Evaluator: JNode selectors, jkey and jvalue, fold fixpoints (packet )
decision.summary: fn:jkey and fn:jvalue get their own part, and the evaluator adds selector interpretation on JNodes, JNode name tests and lookups, numeric predicates, maps and arrays as typed functions, and fold fixpoints.

body.p: . Sections are those of the XPath 4.0 editor's draft vendored with QT4 (PR 2734 for selectors).

item.p: fn:jkey, fn:jvalue move from 2.17 to 2.6: new part src/function_library_jnode.c (F&O 4.0, 16.1.2, 16.1.3; $input as jnode()? := .). Nearly every prod-PathExpr.J and prod-AxisStep.J case uses them; 2.17 no longer writes them. fn:jtree stays in src/function_library_json.c.

Selector interpretation (4.7.3, 4.7.5.4; replaces 's "not done"): in a path's MAP, a JNode N with a non-navigational body (glossary , decided once per MAP from the IR: ".", STEP, a path MAP, DOCUMENT_ORDER, fn:root/TREAT of "/", FILTER of such, union, sequence, conditional, let; tables of 48 entries, beyond that navigational as in Phase 1) evaluates the body and selects the children of N whose jkey is atomic-equal to an item of its atomized value; a body that reads the focus is XPDY0002 there. Task phase bits of the MAP keep the analysis.

Name tests on JNodes: an NCName matches string/anyURI/untypedAtomic keys, a prefixed name or wildcard matches xs:QName keys. The IR does not tell a from Q{}a (both match strings; JAxes-292 waits for lowering). The attribute and namespace axes from a JNode raise XPTY0004 (4.7.5.1).
Lookups on a JNode use the items of its jvalue (each a map or array).

QName key tests ('s proposal, accepted by the orchestrator): a jnode() key test of type xs:QName given as Q{uri}local compares the key's expanded name (names the pool never saw match nothing); other texts are cast as before. Untested end to end: lowering still refuses prefixed QName literals in jnode() (QT4 sequence-type-61). The other proposal, SXML_AXIS_ITEM, needs a tree.h addition and lowering together; not taken here.

Numeric predicates (4.4.1): a value whose first item is numeric selects by "= position()" (any item), an integer range by its bounds; a later non-number is FORG0006 (was FORG0006 for every second item).

Maps and arrays as typed functions (3.2.9, 3.2.10): when the type annotation does not decide it, a map matches function(K) as R for K a single atomic type and R allowing () when every value matches R; an array function(I) as R for I a single integer type when every member matches R.

Fold fixpoints (glossary ): fn:fold-left/-right and array:fold-left/-right stop early when the function is an inline function (through coerced functions whose accumulator parameter and result are item()*) of body if (C) then $acc else E (or the mirror), C a value or general comparison of numeric constants, captured values and $acc, and C holds for the next accumulator: every later call would return it (QT4 fold-left/right-022/023). sxml_evaluator_test_fixpoint is declared in src/evaluator_internal.h (one additive declaration outside the packet's files; 2.0 is done).

Not done here: / and /x from a JNode need lowering to treat as document-node()|jnode() (4.7.1.1; 6 PathExpr.J cases; lowering); fn:function-lookup of focus functions (position#0, last#0) needs the focus at the call, which a leaf row cannot see (lowering); assert-eq on a JNode result needs the driver to atomize (2.16); count(reverse(1 to 10^11)) needs a descending range representation (substrate, 2.17); the O(1) comparison of a range with an integer (RangeExpr-408h, -410h) is ready but waits for tests/xpath_test.c (see "Proposed"). fn-function-lookup stays at 85%: its other 85 failures are functions other packets add.
